items.detail: Eight cases tested 0, 3, 6 and 12 in A-buffer sensitivities at north offsets 5.5 and 6.5 ft; door center x=9 ft was held.
Each nominal five-foot opening lies wholly within its translated porch face, and the generated porch wall segments move with that opening.
Every found route reports its reconstructed gap to the unexpanded owner-protected west-A boundary.
M186, M178, M192, room/porch spec, selected-D, bath-window source, M207 pantry study and owner area/open-connection/A-protection decisions are fingerprinted.
The 0, 3, 6 and 12 in values expand only the route-search obstacle; they do not change bath geometry or assign M-06.
Selected-D remains at the protected source hash.
The M178 8 x 4 ft island is retained in the full-shell route engine.
Owner-protected A and unassigned B remain clear of moved dining/porch blocks; route search keeps both as obstacles.
All table/chair bodies and the four 36-in use-zone proxies fit each translated 11 x 10 ft dining study block.
The translated dining and 12 x 10 ft porch footprints stay inside the 40 x 42 ft shell test.
Every generated M186 route run passes its source and finite-grid contract checks.
Even a path with positive geometric gap remains an unselected schematic candidate.

limitations: Only eight A-buffer/offset combinations are sampled; no exhaustive placement or minimum-area proof is claimed.
Dining and porch footprints are translated as blocks; rough openings, door leaf/swing, thresholds, enclosure and weather detailing are not modeled.
The 24-in stool depth remains an assumption; chair/stool-use rectangles are proxies, not measured product or occupant geometry.
Door center x=9 ft is held; opening and wall-segment alignment is modeled, but product, threshold and operation are not.
The kitchen remains the unapproved 13.5 x 14 ft M178 proposal; appliance-open envelopes, services and site fit are untested.
Revit, IFC, selected-D and Incoming RFAs are unchanged. No code, accessibility, structural, professional, permit or construction-readiness result is established.
